text:
Nora: midday pick-me-up  — Poppy found every puddle between home and the cafe and declared them national parks. pics attached: poppy_puddle_1.jpg, poppy_puddle_2.jpg https://i.imgur.com/poppy1.jpg :corgi: :droplet:
Alex: unstoppable. official title: Director of Puddle Conservation :crown: :joy:
Jamie: that head-tilt at 0:02 in the video is illegal. drop it pls `poppy_splash.mp4` https://i.imgur.com/poppy_vid.mp4
Nora: uploading now. small splash, huge personality. also yes she splashed a squirrel and then gave me the side-eye :sweat_smile:
Priya: petition to make "Mud Boot Monday" a thing so Poppy can lead a march to the office :boots: :raised_hands:
Chris: vote: Poppy as our unofficial team mascot? react :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no
Jamie: +1 she has better branding than my last startup
Alex: +1. also can we make a tiny sash that says "Puddle Mayor"?
Nora: sash is happening. i can sew tonight unless design volunteers :thread:
sticker-bot: :corgi: sticker added
Priya: poll: should we put together a 30-second highlight reel of all the pet cameos for next week's town hall? react :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no
Chris: +1. i'll handle the editing if people send clips by Thursday
Jamie: also question: does Poppy accept official merchandise? asking for reasons.
Nora: she accepts snacks and unsolicited belly rubs. merch idea: enamel pin of Poppy mid-splash. proceeds to local dog rescue?
Alex: love that. design team, any takers to mock a pin? maybe `:poppy-puddle:` emoji too
Priya: i'll ping design and put in the requests doc. also suggesting a short caption for the reel: "tiny splashes, big smiles"
Nora: update: neighborhood kid awarded Poppy a makeshift puddle crown (a paper cup). she wore it for 17 glorious seconds. photo attached: poppy_crown.jpg https://i.imgur.com/poppy_crown.jpg :sparkles:
Chris: coronation. length: 17 seconds of pure leadership. i'm convinced she can run the company.
Jamie: if Poppy runs the company, will she replace all meetings with walk-and-sniffs? i'd be into that.
Alex: final note: someone please remind me to bring actual towels if we do Mud Boot Monday. i volunteer as towel wrangler.
Nora: thanks friends — sending more photos to #pets-highlights and i'll DM design. Poppy says hi but refuses to type. end of thread.
